$comment: Ouro Feel's genres and what good feels like, in its guide's words, lightly trimmed; each `source` is the guide's table row at ouro-ui-apple 700c973.

genres.name: The way back
genres.good: Every screen you reach has a visible way back and a gesture back, and both return you where you were.

genres.name: Overlay dismissal
genres.good: Every sidebar, popover and menu leaves on a tap outside it, and once you pick something.

genres.name: Inside the window
genres.good: Every control sits wholly on screen, in every orientation, and after a turn and back.

genres.name: Tap landing
genres.good: One tap anywhere on a control works, every time, with no second try.

genres.name: Double-draw
genres.good: Each thing is on screen once. No ghost twin mid-transition.

genres.name: Jump after landing
genres.good: Once something lands, it stays landed. No little nudge afterwards.

genres.name: Late or lingering chrome
genres.good: Bars hand over in one beat: never two at once, never a blank between.

genres.name: Snap with no transition
genres.good: Things that move travel there. Nothing teleports.

genres.name: Settle time
genres.good: The screen comes to rest promptly after you act.

genres.name: Place stability
genres.good: Reopen, relaunch or turn the device, and you're exactly where you were.
